title: Traffic Chronicle & Causal Anchors: per-route rollout diagnostics for canaries, A/B and shadow traffic
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Add a unified Console feature called Traffic Chronicle with Causal Anchors that helps engineers reason about per-route behavior during canary rollouts, A/B experiments and shadow traffic runs, and that surfaces automated rollback triggers. The Chronicle combines cohort-diff visualizations, trace-stitching links, per-route distribution charts (latency, token-cost, quality signals), and a causal anchor view that maps anomalous metric deltas to likely upstream causes (model variant, routing policy, region, or batching behavior).

Why: teams struggle to interpret noisy rollout signals across many routes. They need a single pane that ties metric diffs to traces and config changes and recommends safe rollback boundaries. This will reduce mean-time-to-detect and mean-time-to-recover for deployment regressions and make progressive rollouts safer by default.

Scope: Console UX + backend telemetry pipelines + a small rules engine for auto-rollback suggestion. Not included: automated rollback enactment on behalf of customers (out of scope for this ticket; follow-up could request opt-in automation).

Success criteria:
- Engineers can open Chronicle for a rollout and see per-route metric diffs for the last 6 hours with cohort-level histograms and sample traces linked to the Trace Viewer.
- The Causal Anchors panel shows a ranked list of candidate causes for the top three anomalous deltas with confidence estimates.
- Integrations: links to GitHub PR that triggered rollout, runbook link, and the ability to pin a cohort snapshot.
- Telemetry: generate rollout-event markers for canary start/stop, shadow enable/disable and auto-rollback suggestions for fleet-level analytics.

Key UX components:
- Overview strip: traffic split, overall delta score, health thermometer, and quick actions (pause, pin snapshot, open rollback advisor).
- Route cards: per-route charts for latency P50/P95, token consumption per-request, and a quality metric (user-specified eval or default perplexity proxy). Each card includes a cohort difference sparkline and a contextual sample trace link.
- Cohort diff canvas: side-by-side distribution compare with KS distance and percentile drift annotations and the ability to run lightweight A/B hypothesis test.
- Causal Anchors: combines change indicators from model version, region, batching size, and kernel selection with a simple Bayesian score to highlight likely contributors.
- Auto-rollback suggestions: conservative threshold-based flagging; shows what would be rolled back and why (must be acknowledged by operator).

Back-end requirements:
- New rollout_event and cohort_snapshot entities in telemetry store (compact JSON blobs).
- Metric facets for per-route breakdown and hashed route identifiers for privacy-safe grouping.
- Trace stitching API: sample trace IDs returned alongside metric anomalies to enable quick triage.

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Confidence model for Causal Anchors: prototype with heuristic scoring initially; consider ML-based attribution later.
- Storage retention: snapshot retention vs. cost. Default to 30 days for snapshots and 90 days for aggregated metrics.
- Auto-rollback enforcement: keep suggestion-only for initial launch to avoid accidental rollbacks.

Roadmap milestones:
- M1 (2 weeks): Proto UX mockups + API design + telemetry schema.
- M2 (4 weeks): Backend event pipeline + basic cohort diff canvas + sample trace linking.
- M3 (6 weeks): Causal Anchors heuristic + per-route cards + rollout overview strip + QA + docs.

Risks:
- False positives in auto-rollback suggestions could create alert fatigue (mitigation: conservative thresholds).
- High cardinality of routes may increase query costs (mitigation: sampled summaries and hashed grouping).

Deliverables:
- Console pages: /rollouts/:id/chronicle and cohort snapshot modal.
- Telemetry: rollout_event and cohort_shapshot insertion endpoints; rollout markers emitted by serving runtime.
- Docs: runbook snippet for responding to Chronicle findings and recommended rollback criteria.
